decision_rationale: Primary model paper on scRNA-seq that explicitly adds textual descriptions and metadata to language-enhanced single-cell representation learning. The text-bio bridge is central, not just auxiliary.
evidence_snippet: "integrate the fine-grained molecular signals from scRNA-seq with the high-level biological knowledge encoded in textual descriptions and metadata"; "We construct textual descriptions of cells"; "novel multimodal framework" for "language-enhanced representation learning" in single-cell transcriptomics. Evidence for text component: "textual descriptions and metadata"; evidence for text-bio bridge: "integrate ... scRNA-seq with ... textual descriptions"; evidence for generative model: "two-stage pre-training strategy combining discriminative precision with generative flexibility".
